show.description: A gripping thriller about RA&W officer Sher Pathan, who deliberately lands himself inside one of the country’s most dangerous prisons. Haunted by the mysterious death of his sister, he enters a brutal world ruled by corrupt warden Rathod, feared inmate Shera, and hidden alliances. Aarav inches closer to a dark truth. But behind bars, every ally is a risk, and every secret could kill. In this prison, justice isn't blind… it's buried.
